cursing.line: And the turning of day into cursing
stanza: And time was like water, but I was the sea
I wouldn't have noticed it passing
Except for the turning of night into day
And the turning of day into cursing

nursing.line: I walked out on the heart you were nursing
stanza: There's a lonely feeling that I carry
That will follow me all my days
I walked out on the heart you were nursing
Turned my back on a love you saved
Well, just when my clouds were drifting
But there ain't no going back now
And ain't no way that I can change
